about: Models the router may use, with prices in US dollars per million tokens (MTok). 'in'/'out' are standard prices; 'batchIn'/'batchOut' the Batch API prices (half). tier: 1 = simple (picking, yes/no, classification), 2 = standard (proofreading, rewording, pronunciation judgement), 3 = deep (writing articles, research). The router picks the cheapest model whose tier is at least the job's tier, from providers that have a key. A model with no price is used only after priced ones. Update prices whenever you check the providers' pricing pages; set "off": true to stop using a model.
